name_en: Zhongshan Zuoshilong Apparel Co., Ltd. (pinyin; official English name not found)
name_cn: 中山市佐狮龙服饰有限公司
main_products: Men's and women's clothing (Canton Fair category). Exact products not found.
woven_evidence: Not confirmed. It is only listed in the 男女装 zone, and Zhongshan (Shaxi) is a casual-wear cluster that includes knitwear.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The official 138th Canton Fair joint-exhibitor table lists it as the production company partnered with 中山长好企业服务有限公司 in the 男女装 zone (3 booths).

notes: It is officially classed as a production company. Because Zhongshan is a casual-wear hub, Layer 2 should check that it is not a knit specialist. The English name is a transliteration.
